title: poetry does not prefer custom repository but docs say it does
body:

- **OS version and name**: elementary OS 5.1.5 Hera x86_64
- **Poetry version**: 1.1.0a1 / 1.0.9
- **Link of a [Gist](https://gist.github.com/MrGreenTea/ccabb109385da851718bb1e0dd2b10f0) with the contents of your pyproject.toml file**: https://gist.github.com/MrGreenTea/ccabb109385da851718bb1e0dd2b10f0

## Issue

When adding a custom repository that contains a package that also exists on pypi.org, it will be downloaded from pypi.org.
My use case is adding a wheel for typed-ast to my custom repo that works on windows and python 3.9, as such a wheel is not provided on pypi.org yet.
Sadly this does not work and installation on windows fails.
In the [docs](https://python-poetry.org/docs/repositories/#install-dependencies-from-a-private-repository) it says
> Any custom repository will have precedence over PyPI.

The wheel also does not appear in `poetry.lock`:

When I set my custom repository as default and add pypi.org as secondary, it works:
```toml
[[tool.poetry.source]]
name = "custom"
url = "https://example.org/index/+simple"
default = true
[[tool.poetry.source]]
name = "default"
url = 'https://pypi.python.org/simple'
secondary = true
```

With that the `poetry.lock` contains:
```toml
typed-ast = [
    ...
    {file = "typed_ast-1.4.1-cp39-cp39-win32.whl", hash = "sha256:69ee4041ce108cfcaba2b3ce98bfc3d7c87475baabc01c633088cb6afa214d91"},
    {file = "typed_ast-1.4.1-cp39-cp39-win_amd64.whl", hash = "sha256:d0f8433031f09b91d4500ae20edae06b23511369b5bfd1ebf25fa474fe06a03c"},

```
